The stock increased 5.89% or $11.21 during the last trading session, reaching $201.5. About 64.29 million shares traded or 167.61% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since August 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $990.40 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 19.49 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
